svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version G: Version B with owner room sizes
svg.desc: Version G furnished preliminary diagram: Version B with owner-requested room sizes. Bedroom 3 and Bedroom 4 are each 12 by 13 feet clear, the front wall moving 1.5 feet toward the street while the closet pair between them stays recessed 2 feet. Closet 4 is 6 by 5 feet and Closet 3 about 6 by 5.65 feet. The primary bedroom is 14 by 19 feet, its west and north walls each moving 9 inches in; the queen bed, nightstands, desk, chairs and media console remain. Closet 2 is 5 by 6 feet and Bath 2 widens to 9 feet 4 inches by 5 feet. Laundry is 13 by 8 feet with the same counters and 45.3-inch aisle. The mechanical room is 5 by 5 feet. Unfinished attic storage over the north garage, about 299 square feet, remains uncounted and is entered from the mechanical room. Exterior-face gross area including walls and descending stairs, less the actual stair gap, is 1,992.6292 square feet, 7.3708 below 2,000. Facade steps at the primary bedroom and front closet recess, floor framing over the garage, roof and headroom, garage fire separation, furnace sizing and service clearance require professional review.
